rca_of_issue: Root cause: During Sprint E refactoring, the navigation structure was changed from flat 'navItems' array to grouped 'navSections' array. Line 351 in the header breadcrumb section was not updated to use the new structure. Fix: Replace navItems.find() with navSections.flatMap(s => s.items).find() to search across all section items.
